fullRegression2.interpretation: runExtract exceeded its 20 s spawnSync limit before any schema or byte-equality assertion ran; no extractor output was compared.

assessment.kind: transient subprocess timeout, not a byte or schema behavior regression
evidence: The failing assertion is the spawnSync status check (null !== 0) after ETIMEDOUT; it is not a diff of extracted bytes or schema output.
The same commit 3a1ac77a8 passed the same test on rerun attempt 2.
The same test passed in full-regression (1) during attempt 1 at 14.38 s, below the 20 s limit.
The test after the failure passed at 14.98 s, close to the same 20 s limit.
assessment.unknown: The specific cause of the 36.19 s runtime in full-regression (2) attempt 1 is not proven. The runner executes generated tests, the Hermes adapter and the root suite before the module wrapper, and the root suite runs four files concurrently; that load was not measured. The rerun shows the output is deterministic, not that the timeout cause is known.
assessment.coverageNote: Complete CI runs the module suite twice: full-regression (1) runs test:code-analysis directly, and full-regression (2)'s root shard includes test/code-analysis.test.mjs, which spawns the same module suite.
